fields.name: package_name
fields.title: Package Name
fields.description: Canonical registry name of the package

fields.name: dependency_name
fields.title: Dependency Name
fields.description: Alias name as declared in the project manifest (same as package_name when no alias is used)

fields.name: dependency_type
fields.title: Dependency Type
fields.description: Whether this is a production or development dependency

fields.name: is_optional_dependency
fields.title: Is Optional Dependency
fields.description: Whether this is a development/optional dependency

fields.name: installed_version
fields.title: Installed Version
fields.description: Currently installed version

fields.name: latest_version
fields.title: Latest Version
fields.description: Latest available version from registry

fields.name: time_lag_days
fields.title: Time Lag (Days)
fields.description: Days between installed and latest version release

fields.name: version_age_days
fields.title: Version Age (Days)
fields.description: Days since the installed version was published to the registry

fields.name: releases_lag
fields.title: Releases Lag
fields.description: Number of releases between installed and latest

fields.name: cve_count
fields.title: CVE Count
fields.description: Number of known CVEs for this package

fields.name: version_constraint
fields.title: Version Constraint
fields.description: Version specifier declared in the project manifest (e.g. '^1.2.3', '>=1.0,<2.0')

fields.name: constraint_type
fields.title: Constraint Type
fields.description: How the version constraint was applied: DECLARED (loose/default spec), NARROWED (explicit range with bounds), PINNED (exact version), ADDITIVE (narrows via constraints file), or OVERRIDE (forces a version regardless of other requirements)

fields.name: constraint_source_file
fields.title: Constraint Source File
fields.description: File that introduced a non-DECLARED constraint (e.g. 'package.json', 'pyproject.toml', 'requirements.txt')

fields.name: extras
fields.title: Extras
fields.description: PyPI extras requested for this dependency, comma-separated (e.g. 'security,tests'); empty when none

fields.name: is_prerelease
fields.title: Is Pre-release
fields.description: Whether the installed version is a pre-release (alpha/beta/rc/dev)

fields.name: is_yanked
fields.title: Is Yanked
fields.description: Whether the installed version has been yanked or unpublished from the registry

fields.name: is_deprecated
fields.title: Is Deprecated
fields.description: Whether the installed package or version is deprecated (npm-only; false otherwise)

fields.name: is_package_unpublished
fields.title: Is Package Unpublished
fields.description: Whether the entire package has been removed from the registry (npm-only; false otherwise)

fields.name: epss
fields.title: EPSS
fields.description: Highest EPSS score among this package's CVEs; empty when no CVE is scored

fields.name: runs_code_at_install
fields.title: Runs Code At Install
fields.description: Whether the installed version executes arbitrary code during install; empty when unknown

fields.name: stability_csi
fields.title: Maintained Probability
fields.description: P(maintained) from the maintenance-state model (1 - stability_risk); empty when no observation was available

fields.name: stability_risk
fields.title: Not-Maintained Risk
fields.description: P(abandoned) + P(deprecated) from the maintenance-state model; the value that feeds triage

fields.name: maintenance_state
fields.title: Maintenance State
fields.description: Most probable maintenance state

fields.name: flow_trend
fields.title: Issue/PR Flow Trend
fields.description: Direction of the issue/PR flow ratio over the engagement window

fields.name: deprecation_signals
fields.title: Deprecation Signals
fields.description: Comma-separated explicit end-of-life markers found

fields.name: deprecation_successor
fields.title: Deprecation Successor
fields.description: Replacement package named in the metadata / deprecation message / README

fields.name: days_since_push
fields.title: Days Since Push
fields.description: Days since the last push to the upstream repository; empty when unknown

fields.name: triage_action
fields.title: Triage Action
fields.description: Recommended action from the EPSS x maintenance matrix

fields.name: gap_cv
fields.title: Gap CV
fields.description: Coefficient of variation of inter-commit gaps from the last 100 commits; empty below 20 sampled gaps

fields.name: silence_days
fields.title: Silence Days
fields.description: Days since the most recent sampled commit; empty when no commit was sampled

fields.name: silence_p
fields.title: Silence P-Value
fields.description: Empirical probability, from this repository's own gap history, of a silence this long

fields.name: commits_sampled
fields.title: Commits Sampled
fields.description: Non-bot commits that entered the gap measurement

fields.name: license
fields.title: License
fields.description: SPDX license identifier or license name as declared in the package registry

fields.name: purl
fields.title: Package URL (PURL)
fields.description: Package URL per ECMA-386, e.g. pkg:pypi/requests@2.25.1 or pkg:npm/lodash@4.17.21
